instruction: Makefile has a 'missing separator' error — recipes were indented with spaces. Fix it (tab-indented recipes) so `make greet` prints 'hello' and `make clean` removes out.txt.
setup:
cat > Makefile <<'EOF'
greet:
    echo hello

out.txt:
    echo data > out.txt

clean:
    rm -f out.txt
EOF

grader.script: make greet | grep -qx hello && make out.txt && test -f out.txt && make clean && test ! -f out.txt

oracle.script:
printf 'greet:
	echo hello

out.txt:
	echo data > out.txt

clean:
	rm -f out.txt
' > Makefile
